articles.title: Quote of the day by Ernest Hemingway: 'But man is not made for defeat. A man can be destroyed but not defeated.' Life lessons on courage, perseverance and rising above adversity
articles.description: Quote of the Day by Ernest Hemingway: Ernest Hemingway captures the essence of human resilience through his famous quote, suggesting that while life can break or overwhelm a person, it cannot necessarily defeat their spirit. He explores this theme vividly in his acclaimed novel The Old Man and the Sea, which follows a protagonist struggling against seemingly overwhelming challenges. Hemingway’s powerful reflections on perseverance and courage continue to resonate today, reminding us that adversity may test us, but our ability to rise, endure and keep moving forward can shape who we become.

articles.title: Satya Niketan is Emptying Out: Building Collapse Sends Students Fleeing Their PGs
articles.description: Two days after a building collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan, suitcases and backpacks have become the new normal in its narrow lanes. Students are calling parents, scouting new accommodation, and some are sleeping in colleges at night, too scared to stay. Several nearby buildings have been flagged "unsafe," and one is already being vacated for demolition. Residents say poor ventilation, dangerous staircases, and inadequate fire safety have long been ignored in the area. For many students, the choice now comes down to two things: affordability, and staying alive.
